sections.name: Listening Section
sections.prompt: Nghe audio và trả lời câu hỏi: The speaker talks about green architecture. What is the main argument?
sections.passage: Good morning class. Today we will examine how modern buildings integrate green vertical gardens. The objective is not merely aesthetic elegance. It is, in fact, highly pragmatic: reducing heat radiation in core cities...
options: B. Reducing heat radiation in cities
